title: Hydration: attaching React to server HTML

slides.say: With server rendering, the user first sees plain HTML. Hydration is React attaching to that HTML and making it interactive.
Call hydrate root with the DOM node and your app. React attaches to the existing HTML and takes over managing it.

slides.text: Client’s first render must produce the SAME output as the server. Mismatches are bugs.
slides.say: The first client render must produce exactly the same output as the server. Treat mismatches as bugs.
Common causes: checks like type of window in render, browser only APIs, or extra whitespace around the root HTML.
